mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 2% over three consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) of more than 2% coincident with a rise in the unemployment rate above 4% signals weakening aggregate demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 0.5% for three consecutive months signals improving supply capacity and corporate earnings momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +1%) in at least 60% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% accompanied by a concurrent acceleration in average hourly earnings (proxied by PAYEMS growth) signals a tight labor market and upward wage pressure, which historically precedes negative equity risk premia and lower S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 55% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1 million units for four consecutive months signals weakening residential investment and consumer sentiment, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 60% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp one-month increase in CPIAUCSL above 4% while FEDFUNDS remains below 2% signals an unexpected inflation shock not yet met by policy tightening, which historically precedes positive equity returns as markets anticipate future rate hikes and inflation hedging via equities over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +1%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.4 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which historically precede negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of regime.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 50% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent monthly rise in industrial production (INDPRO) and personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above 0.5% signals synchronized expansion in supply and demand, which typically boosts corporate earnings and supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +1%) in at least 60% of triggered quarters.
